blocks.text: Korean heartthrob Ahn Bo-hyun is starring in Prime Video’s new historical drama “Sacred Jewel,” which serves up royal intrigue during the turbulent Goryeo dynasty. Ahn is cast alongside Claudia Kim (Gyeongseong Creaturen, Avengers: Age of Ultron) as star-crossed lovers in the 14-episode period series, which will make a global premiere this December. READ: Ahn Bo-hyun, Lee Joo-been engage in fiery romance in ‘Spring Fever’ Set in 1258, “Sacred Jewel” takes the audience back to a time when a war-torn kingdom, battered by nearly three decades of Mongol invasions, stands on the brink of total collapse.
